depth_units: feet; 10 ft contour intervals, confirmed by the official Hoover fishing map PDF
notes: The ODNR bathymetry service has no survey-date field. Its Hoover DT_ADDED value is June 10, 2014.
The survey and revision years above are printed on the linked official ODNR Hoover fishing map PDF.
Written ODNR permission applies to Hoover only. Never render another lake without its own permission.
The static map uses only ODNR depth bands at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 ft. No intermediate contours or depths are interpolated.
Roads, small contour labels, place names, dam, north arrow and facility symbols are redrawn from the retained official ODNR PDF.
Named boat-ramp markers use coordinates and names from js/hoover-map-data.js and the official City of Columbus sources in DATA-SOURCES.md.
